offering_description.value: Owns, leases, develops and manages modern logistics and distribution warehouses for businesses. Customers include e-commerce, retail, transportation and manufacturing companies. It also manages investment funds and offers energy and mobility solutions at its properties.

primary_services.value: industrial warehouse leasing; property development; property and asset management; investment fund management; on-site solar and EV charging energy services

customer_segment.value: B2B: e-commerce, retail, third-party logistics, transportation and manufacturing tenants, institutional investors in funds

end_markets.value: logistics and supply chain; e-commerce; retail; manufacturing; transportation

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: rent from tenants of logistics warehouses; commissions or management fees: asset and property management fees from co-investment ventures and funds; project or contract: development gains from building and selling or contributing properties; service fees: energy, solar and mobility solutions for customers
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; commissions or management fees; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates logistics warehouses and leases them to businesses; service provider: develops properties and manages investment funds for institutional investors

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Latin America (Mexico, Brazil) and Asia (Japan, Singapore)

specialization.value: related lines: logistics warehouse ownership, development, fund management and energy services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house leasing teams working with tenants; agents / brokers: commercial real estate brokers representing tenants

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: real estate investment trust tax rules, zoning, land use, environmental and building regulations, securities rules for funds
